dialogues.speaker: Aryna
dialogues.text: Oh dear, did you lose your companion? That must be so worrying...

dialogues.speaker: Aryna
dialogues.text: Let's see what we can do... Hmm, we could post a notice, yes, but sitting here and waiting may not be the best use of your time. Why not go search for them yourself? Better to hold the reins in your own hands than leave your heart at the mercy of chance, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Aryna
dialogues.text: So, dear, listen to me — why don't you ask the attendants on the platform? I'm sure they'll be glad to help you look. I think Iliana is on duty today... or is it Sochikov?

dialogues.speaker: Aryna
dialogues.text: Well, either way, they'll be in uniform. So go on, dear. Take a look on the platform. I promise you'll spot them right away.
